enso.label: El Niño Advisory
enso.quote: A moderate to strong El Niño is present in the Tropical Pacific.

sources.forecast: ECMWF SEAS5 seasonal ensemble via Open-Meteo
sources.soil: ERA5 root-zone soil moisture (28–100 cm) via Open-Meteo archive
sources.heat: Feels-like max temperature, ERA5 + Open-Meteo forecast
sources.projection: CMIP6 EC-Earth3P-HR via Open-Meteo climate API
sources.seaLevel: IPCC AR6 sea-level projections, NASA Sea Level Projection Tool (SSP2-4.5, medium confidence)
